block.guhs.botenhuisje_steigerlantaarn.l: Lights up by itself when it gets dark. For the end of your jetty
block.guhs.botenhuisje_hengelstandaard.l: No hook, just a blossom petal. That's how the Fisher Guh fishes
block.guhs.botenhuisje_koiwindzak.lore: A cheerful koi on a pole, for by the water
structure.guhs.botenhuisje.tooltip: A light little boathouse with a jetty on a Blossom Lake: the Fisher Guh lends you his rowboat
structure.guhs.picknickeilandje.tooltip: Rare: guhs celebrate hanami under the biggest blossom tree of an island in a Blossom Lake
gui.guhs.roeibootje.te_ver: The rowboat belongs to its lake, nyeg. It bobs back to the jetty.
gui.guhs.roeibootje.geroepen: A rowboat is waiting for you at the mooring post.
gui.guhs.roeibootje.ligt_klaar: The rowboat is already waiting. Hop in!
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.optie.koivoer: Got some koi food for me?
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.optie.meer_bezig: What was I supposed to do again?
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.optie.meer_klaar: Tell me about the lake again
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koivoer: Here, a handful of koi food. Scatter it on the water and they'll come by themselves, nyeg. I'll have some more for you tomorrow.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koivoer_op: I'm out of food for today, chonk. The koi shouldn't get too chubby either. Come back tomorrow.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.bootje: Of course, nyeg. It's at the mooring post, hop in. Row wherever you like, as long as it's on the lake. If you leave it somewhere, it bobs away by itself and there'll be one waiting here again. That boat knows the lake better than I do.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.begin: You want to get to know the lake, nyeg? That can't be rushed. Four little things. First: feed a koi. Here's some koi food. Scatter it on the water by the jetty and watch what happens.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.voer_nog: Feed a koi first, chonk. Scatter the koi food on the water, right where they swim. No rush. They'll come.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.voer_klaar: Did you see that, nyeg? They don't come for you, they come for the food. But they stay for the company. Two: blossom petals float on the water. Bring me one. Pick it up gently, they're thin.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.blaadje_nog: A floating blossom petal, chonk. They lie on the water, mostly under the trees. One is enough.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.blaadje_klaar: Thank you, chonk. This petal fell from the tree, floated a little circle and now lies in my paw. Everything here goes in circles like that. Three: take the rowboat and row to a big island. Step out for a moment and look around.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.eiland_nog: The rowboat is at the mooring post, nyeg. Row to a big island, one with a good-sized tree, and step out for a moment. A stepping stone doesn't count. You don't even fit on one.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.eiland_klaar: You've been to the island, I can tell by your ears. Nyeg. From there this jetty is just a little line, isn't it? That's how small we are. The last one: catch a koi. Here's my bucket, scoop up water with it and then a koi. And then set it free again. That last part matters most.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.koi_nog: First scoop water into the bucket, chonk, and then a koi. Easy does it. And then you let it swim again.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.koi_loslaten: You've got one in your bucket, nyeg. Well done. And now the hard part: letting go. Pour it back into the water.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.klaar: Caught and set free again. Wahoog. Now you know the lake, nyeg: you may hold anything for a while, as long as you give it back. Here, for your own little spot by the water.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.klaar.chat: You know the lake! The Fisher Guh gave you two jetty lanterns, a fishing rod on a stand and a koi windsock.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.les.na: You already know the lake, chonk. Now all you have to do is come and sit. That's the hardest thing of all, nyeg.
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.voer: Feed a koi: scatter koi food on the water where koi swim
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.blaadje: Bring the Fisher Guh a floating blossom petal
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.eiland: Row the rowboat to a big island and step ashore
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.koi: Catch a koi with a bucket of water, and set it free again
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.loslaten: Set the koi from your bucket free in the water again
quest.guhs.botenhuisje.terug: Go back to the Fisher Guh on the jetty
gui.guhs.picknickeilandje.mand.pak: A treat from the picnic basket, from the hanami guhs. For you!
gui.guhs.picknickeilandje.mand.gehad: You've already had your treat, nyeg. The rest is for whoever comes next.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.ochtend.0: Good morning, nyeg. The mist still hangs over the water and the koi are sleeping in. So am I, really.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.ochtend.1: Up early, chonk? In the morning the lake is at its quietest. Just listen. ... Exactly. Nothing. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.middag.0: Ha, nyeg. Have a seat. The koi do their rounds and I do mine: sitting.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.middag.1: You know what's nice about fishing, chonk? You don't have to catch anything. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.avond.0: Look, the lantern is lighting up. That's how I know it's evening, nyeg. I don't have a watch. The lake is never late.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.avond.1: The sun sinks into the water and the koi turn to gold. Every single evening. Wahoog, right?
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.nacht.0: Shh, nyeg. The koi are asleep. I'm fishing for stars now: they don't bite either, but they reflect nicely.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.nacht.1: Still awake, chonk? Me too. At night you can hear the blossom fall. Plop. Plop. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koi.0: They never bite, nyeg, that's why I don't fish for them. There's no hook on my line, just a blossom petal. The koi come to look, I look back. That's how we catch each other a little.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koi.1: A koi lives to be a hundred, they say. So it has all the time in the world, nyeg. A guh could learn from that. I practice every day.
gui.guhs.botenhuisje.visser.koi.2: I used to want to catch the biggest koi in the lake. Now I know: the biggest koi is the one you let swim. Chonk. Deep, right? Just like the lake.
gui.guhs.hanami.lief.0: Look up, nyeg. Every petal falls only once. That's why we watch.
gui.guhs.hanami.lief.1: Come sit with us, chonk. There's cake. And blossom. That's all you need.
gui.guhs.hanami.lief.2: Shh... that one's asleep. Been tired of watching since the very first petal. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.hanami.lief.3: Hanami! That means: flower watching. We do it every year. And every day. Wahoog, you're here too!
gui.guhs.hanami.guh.0: Nyeg! Blossom! There! And there! And there too!
gui.guhs.hanami.guh.1: There are treats in the basket. Go on, there's something for everyone. Chonk!
gui.guhs.hanami.slaap.0: Zzz... nyeg... one more petal... zzz
